name: @tibame201020/queqiao
description: One secure bridge between AI clients and multiple coding environments.

scripts.prepack: npm run check && npm run build:package
scripts.test:security: vitest run packages/platform-paths/src/index.test.ts apps/cli/src/runtime-migration.test.ts apps/gateway/src/security-baseline.test.ts apps/gateway/src/config.test.ts apps/gateway/src/request-budget.test.ts apps/gateway/src/worker-client.test.ts apps/gateway/src/worker-registry.test.ts apps/worker/src/permission.test.ts packages/policy/src/index.test.ts packages/security/src/approval.test.ts packages/security/src/canonical-request.test.ts packages/workspace/src/index.test.ts packages/process-runtime/src/index.test.ts
scripts.test:cluster: vitest run apps/gateway/src/worker-client.test.ts apps/gateway/src/worker-registry.test.ts apps/worker/src/permission.test.ts apps/gateway/src/app.test.ts
scripts.security:gate: npm run typecheck && npm run test:security && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=moderate
scripts.check: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && npm test
